title: Personal Training Packages: pausing and resuming a package
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states the basis on which a package may be paused and how its expiration date is treated once it resumes.

## Rule
Where a tier allows pausing, a package on that tier may be paused for up to the tier's own maximum pause length, charged the tier's own pause fee. Once the package resumes, its expiration date is pushed back by the number of days the package was actually paused.

## Points of judgement
The pause fee, where the tier lists one, is charged at the time the package is paused, regardless of how many days the pause ultimately lasts. The expiration-date adjustment on resumption is based on the number of days the package was actually paused, not on the tier's own maximum pause length: a package paused for fewer days than the maximum has its expiration date pushed back by only that shorter actual number of days, while a package paused for the full maximum allowed length has its expiration date pushed back by that full length.
